subject: Geopolitics
title: The African Union
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The African Union.

hook.text: The African Union has 55 members. It tries to solve Africa's problems from within — but enforcement is weak.

buildup.text: Founded in 2002, the AU replaced the Organisation of African Unity. It added peacekeeping and governance mandates.

discovery.text: The AU deploys peacekeepers in Somalia, South Sudan, and the Sahel. African solutions for African problems is the motto.

twist.text: The AU's budget depends on foreign donors. How can you assert independence when others fund your operations?

climax.text: Despite limits, the AU gives Africa a collective voice. Its seat at the G20 in 2023 was a diplomatic milestone.

punchline.text: Unity is strongest when the weakest members are heard.

quiz.question: What limits the African Union's independence?
options: Dependence on foreign donors for its budget
